summary: Materialized attention rows expose the canonical urgent flag, matching full attention reads

replay.detail: The local person-step and custom attention IVM families rebuild under the public-row.v4.urgent fingerprint so cached public rows include urgent, including false for non-critical asks. The rebuild is local and does not change recorded claims.

schema.detail: No new claim or API fields; materialized rows now populate the existing urgent field.

rules.detail: Both readers use the existing canonical rule: only a critical ask is urgent.

compatibility.detail: Upgraded daemons rebuild their local attention families. Older daemons may still omit urgent from materialized rows; full reads and recorded claims remain compatible.

downtime.detail: No service interruption; local attention families rebuild automatically.

recovery.detail: Rollback restores the older local projection fingerprint and may omit urgent from materialized rows; recorded claims are unchanged.
